name: Avatar
import: import { Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback, AvatarBadge } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/avatar';
description: Avatar — circular (or squircle) identity marker on
whenToUse: Showing who: a person, a team or an account next to their name — in lists, comments, menus.
Photo when there is one, initials otherwise (`type` image / text / icon).

whenNotToUse.text: Several people in a small space

anatomy.description: image with `alt`, initials, or an icon; falls back to initials if the image fails.
`size` sm/md/lg (32/48/64), circle for people, square for teams and orgs.

do.caption: Initials beside the full name — the name carries meaning, the avatar helps scanning.
do.example: Dana Stoyanova

dont.caption: Initials alone: DS, DM, DK — who is who?

a11y: An image avatar needs `alt` with the person’s name — unless the name is right next to it, then `alt=""`.
Initials are read letter by letter; give the name in visible text nearby.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Avatar — circular (or squircle) identity marker on

props.name: alt
props.description: `type="image"`: required alt text — announced in place of the photo.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Fill for `AvatarFallback` when using the `type` shorthand (`text`/`icon`/an image's fallback). Independent of `outline`.

props.name: fallback
props.description: `type="image"`: shown while the image loads or if it fails to load. Falls back to `initials`, then `icon`.

props.name: outline
props.description:
Ring around the avatar, drawn as two nested rings per Figma: an outer
colored ring (`'solid'` = flat `--color-border-border-primary`,
`'gradient'` = the conic sweep above) and, inside it, a background-color
separator ring so the colored ring doesn't sit flush against the photo.
`'none'` (not in Figma's variant set, added for flexibility) skips both
and lets `AvatarImage`/`AvatarFallback` fill the full shape.

props.name: separator
props.description:
The background-color separator ring between the colored `outline` ring
and the content (Figma's `innerOutline`). On by default; set `false` to
let the colored ring sit flush against the photo/fallback instead. No
effect when `outline="none"`.

props.name: type
props.description:
Shorthand for Figma's Type variant — renders the matching content
(`icon`/`src`+`alt`/`initials` below) without composing
`AvatarImage`/`AvatarFallback` by hand. Omit `type` and pass
`AvatarImage`/`AvatarFallback`/`AvatarBadge` as `children` directly for
full control (e.g. a custom fallback delay, or a badge).

components.name: AvatarBadge
components.description:
Counter/status badge pinned to the top-right corner — a positioned
`BadgeIndicator`. Pass as a sibling of `AvatarImage`/`AvatarFallback`
inside `Avatar`. Positions itself against `Avatar`'s own root (the only
positioned ancestor in the tree), so it isn't clipped by the ring nesting
even though it's DOM-nested inside it. Pass short content (a number,
"9+") via `value`/children, `dot` for a plain status dot, or `icon`.

props.name: dot
props.description: Renders a plain dot instead of `value`/`icon` — takes priority over both.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon content (sized by BadgeIndicator, colored via currentColor). Ignored when `dot` is set.

props.name: pulse
props.description:
Draw attention to something new: two rings spread from the badge, three times, then
it rests (well under 5 seconds — WCAG 2.2.2). Change `pulseKey` (e.g. to the new
item's id) to play it again. Skipped with reduced motion.

props.name: pulseKey
props.description: Replays the pulse whenever it changes.

props.name: separator
props.description:
Ring in the surface background color, separating the badge from the
avatar/photo underneath (Figma's separator ring, same idea as `Avatar`'s
own `separator` prop). On by default.
